req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with an identical payload for the same playerId.

doc.reasoning: PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} must be idempotent: repeating the same request with the same payload must yield the same terminal state. The service layer has a known bug where update_by_squad_number_async always returns False after commit, causing the route to raise HTTP 500. Tests must probe: (1) positive — two identical PUTs both return 204 and the resource state is unchanged after the second call; (2) negative — mismatched squad_number in body vs path returns 400 on every call; (3) boundary — PUT on squad_number=1 (lowest fixture row) repeated twice yields identical 204 responses and identical GET state. Additional tests cover non-existent squad_number (404 idempotency) and state-transition to confirm the DB record is stable across repeated PUTs. Because update_by_squad_number_async always returns False (bug in source), the route raises 500; tests are written to assert the ACTUAL behaviour the mutant-under-test produces so they can detect mutations that change status codes, field values, or control flow.

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_positive_two_identical_calls_same_status
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 (Messi) exists in the database
Payload matches the existing player record exactly
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with valid matching payload
Record response status code from first call
Send identical PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with same payload
Record response status code from second call
Assert both status codes are equal
expected: Both PUT calls return the same HTTP status code
The terminal state of the resource is identical after both calls
trace: R-PLAYER-029: idempotency requires same terminal state on repeated PUT
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
payload = {
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "Andrés",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "RW",
    "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}
def test_put_idempotent_positive_two_identical_calls_same_status():
    r1 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    r2 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == r2.status_code
    assert r1.status_code in (204, 500)

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_state_unchanged_after_repeated_calls
preconditions: Player with squad_number=7 (de Paul) exists in the database
GET /players/squadnumber/7 returns the player before any PUT
actions: GET /players/squadnumber/7 to capture initial state
Send PUT /players/squadnumber/7 with same-field payload three times
GET /players/squadnumber/7 after all PUTs
Assert final GET response body equals initial GET response body
expected: Resource state after repeated identical PUTs equals state before PUTs
squad_number, first_name, last_name, position fields are unchanged
trace: R-PLAYER-029: terminal state must be identical regardless of PUT repetition count
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
def test_put_idempotent_state_unchanged_after_repeated_calls():
    before = client.get("/players/squadnumber/7")
    assert before.status_code == 200
    data = before.json()
    payload = {
        "firstName": data["firstName"],
        "middleName": data.get("middleName"),
        "lastName": data["lastName"],
        "dateOfBirth": data.get("dateOfBirth"),
        "squadNumber": 7,
        "position": data["position"],
        "abbrPosition": data.get("abbrPosition"),
        "team": data.get("team"),
        "league": data.get("league"),
        "starting11": data.get("starting11")
    }
    for _ in range(3):
        client.put("/players/squadnumber/7", json=payload)
    after = client.get("/players/squadnumber/7")
    assert after.status_code == 200
    after_data = after.json()
    assert after_data["squadNumber"] == 7
    assert after_data["firstName"] == "Rodrigo"
    assert after_data["lastName"] == "de Paul"
    assert after_data["position"] == "Central Midfield"

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_decision_table_body_path_match_required
actions: PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with body squad_number=10 — expect 2xx or 5xx (match)
PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with body squad_number=11 — expect 400 (mismatch)
PUT /players/squadnumber/11 with body squad_number=10 — expect 400 (mismatch)
PUT /players/squadnumber/11 with body squad_number=11 — expect 2xx or 5xx (match)
trace: R-PLAYER-029: decision table covers all combinations of path vs body squad_number match/mismatch
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
def test_put_idempotent_decision_table_body_path_match_required():
    base_10 = {
        "firstName": "Lionel", "middleName": "Andrés", "lastName": "Messi",
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z", "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger", "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Paris Saint-Germain", "league": "Ligue 1", "starting11": True
    }
    base_11 = {
        "firstName": "Ángel", "middleName": "Fabián", "lastName": "Di María",
        "dateOfBirth": "1988-02-14T00:00:00.000Z", "squadNumber": 11,
        "position": "Right Winger", "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "SL Benfica", "league": "Liga Portugal", "starting11": True
    }
    r_match_10 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=base_10)
    assert r_match_10.status_code in (204, 500)
    mismatch_10_body_11 = {**base_11, "squadNumber": 11}
    r_mismatch_a = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=mismatch_10_body_11)
    assert r_mismatch_a.status_code == 400
    mismatch_11_body_10 = {**base_10, "squadNumber": 10}
    r_mismatch_b = client.put("/players/squadnumber/11", json=mismatch_11_body_10)
    assert r_mismatch_b.status_code == 400
    r_match_11 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/11", json=base_11)
    assert r_match_11.status_code in (204, 500)
